why_trail.why: Loaded Scout and shared doctrine, ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT, Cartographer map model, workflow templates, tests, and run feedback; no instantiated docs/architecture map exists in this source repo, so the documented map model and design artifacts are the current architecture substitute.

More tagging is a non-finding.
